text: BFSU Training College provides a Chinese Translation training program (including translation and interpretation) to help the trainees (esp. foreigners working in China as translators and interpreters) toimprove their skill in Chinese translation and interpretation. Characteristics: 1. Emphasis on strengthening the skills in Chinese translation and interpretation to help the trainees to bridge the gap between languages and cultures; 2. Two-way translation and interpretation; 3. From consecutive interpreting to simultaneous interpreting. Application Time Applicants can apply all year around, and the program is opened as long as there are over 15 enrolments. Class Time Saturday &Sunday: 1.30pm - 5.20pm, 72 class hours in total Class No. 11BCH17
